Frames 3-4: the surface turns choppy with many white breaking caps, large foam patches at the left edge. Frames 5-8: big whitecaps break in the lower left and lower middle (frame 5-6 lower left, frame 7-8 lower middle-right) while a wave ridge forms across the upper half.
